title: Coronado Fups Powdercoated Bullbar #13
description: Coronado FUPS compliant powder coated hi-tensile aluminium heavy duty road train Bullbar. 6mm wall 88mm wide heavy duty box uprights extended through to lower main protection bar. Main cross tubes are one piece high tensile tube, no but welds, passing through the centre box uprights and recessed into outer uprights. Driving light mounts to customer specification. Reversible Road Train signs plus fold down Oversize sign. LED combination indicator/parking lights are fitted to mounting plates on top of the heavy duty pressed main channel. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. A wide choice of colours available or the bar can be fully polished. 100mm wide uprights option available. All bars can be Custom Built to your requirements.
